items.title: Boost for Italy’s world-class engineering as Edgewing lands in Turin
items.excerpt: Edgewing opened a Turin engineering hub for the Italy-Japan-UK GCAP aircraft. Engineers from all three nations will support the advanced concept and assessment phase and establish digital capabilities for design and development.

items.title: ispace, Leonardo and Telespazio Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Collaborate on Lunar Exploration
items.excerpt: The companies signed an MoU to explore lunar communications, navigation and transportation collaboration, including Leonardo’s space robotics and AI capabilities. Potential work includes interoperability, user terminals and Moonlight satellite transportation.

items.title: Leonardo selected to help shape Europe’s future sovereign Earth observation capability
items.excerpt: ESA awarded Leonardo a funded study for the future EU Earth Observation Governmental Service architecture. The consortium will assess gaps and architectural alternatives spanning sensors, space systems, ground infrastructure, processing and services.

items.title: Leonardo, MAFA and BELTCON to supply baggage automation for Medina airport Terminal 2
items.excerpt: A new Terminal 2 contract introduces Leonardo’s MBHS cross-belt sorter in Saudi Arabia. Leonardo will supply the sorter and Sort Allocation Computer for baggage routing and airport-system integration with MAFA and BELTCON.

items.title: Innovative solutions for the next generation of business jets: Liebherr at NBAA-BACE 2026
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: Liebherr’s planned NBAA-BACE display covers landing gear, air-management systems and modular electromechanical actuators for business jets. The company highlights smaller actuators, electrification, weight reduction and compact installation requirements.

items.title: Liebherr-Aerospace and China Airlines reach an agreement for Airbus A350 nose landing gear overhaul
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: China Airlines selected Liebherr for nose-landing-gear exchange and overhaul across 18 Airbus A350 aircraft. The campaign starts in 2026 and runs through 2031, with asset exchanges supporting maintenance planning and fleet availability.

items.title: Liebherr-Aerospace participates in MRO Asia-Pacific 2026
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: Liebherr announced it would present Asia-Pacific customer-service solutions at MRO Asia-Pacific in Singapore on September 22–24, 2026. The official news listing confirms the publication date and event details; the article body was not retrievable.

items.title: Woodward to Provide Actuation System for Aircraft Folding Wing Demonstrator
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: Woodward will supply Airbus' ground-based folding-wing demonstrator with an actuation system, including a power delivery unit and high-power hinge actuator. Work includes hydraulic-versus-electric design trade studies; testing is planned in Bremen and Bristol.
items.query: site.woodward.com (news OR newsroom OR technology OR investor) after:2026-09-11 before:2026-10-13

items.title: Woodward Plans to Transition Its Santa Clarita, California, Aerospace Controls Production to Spartanburg, South Carolina
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: Woodward plans to transfer military fixed-wing and rotorcraft flight-control actuation production to Spartanburg. The new plant is expected online in summer 2027, also producing Airbus A350 spoiler actuation systems. Santa Clarita operations are expected to end by December 2027.
items.query: site.woodward.com (news OR newsroom OR technology OR investor) after:2026-09-11 before:2026-10-13

items.title: Parker Hannifin 2026 Annual Report
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: Parker’s September 18 annual-report filing records FY2026 company-wide R&D of $267 million and development-contract pre-production expense of $43 million. It cites aircraft platforms and MRO demand as aerospace growth drivers; Aerospace Systems backlog was $8.498 billion at June 30. These are issuer-reported figures.
items.query: site.parker.com (aerospace OR propulsion OR manufacturing OR MRO) (news OR press OR technology) after:2026-09-11 before:2026-10-13

items.title: Howmet Aerospace to Host Webcast and Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results
items.excerpt: Howmet scheduled its Q3 2026 results for October 29, with release and slides at about 7 a.m. ET and a webcast at 10 a.m. ET. This is an investor-calendar notice rather than a new engineering or manufacturing result.
items.query: site:howmet.com ("2026" "September" OR "2026" "October") (news OR aerospace OR manufacturing OR materials)

items.title: AI Readiness Starts with Product Data: 5 Trends Shaping the Future of Electronics and High Tech
items.excerpt: PTC's E&HT Exchange recap identifies connected lifecycle data, PLM–ERP integration and interoperable digital threads as prerequisites for engineering AI. It discusses knowledge reuse and change-impact analysis; it reports no measured productivity gain or controlled validation.

items.title: 「LH₂ BOG圧縮機」が川崎LH₂ターミナル向けに採用
items.category: ガスタービン・技術サービス
items.excerpt: IHI says its rotating-machinery subsidiary's liquid-hydrogen boil-off-gas compressor was selected for Kawasaki's LH₂ terminal. The design uses vacuum insulation for approximately −240°C gas intake, a three-chamber seal arrangement and cryogenic-compatible materials. This is terrestrial hydrogen infrastructure, not an aircraft engine.
items.query: site:ihi.co.jp 2026 10 航空 エンジン 技術 ニュース after:2026-09-12 before:2026-10-13

items.title: ドイツ子会社 Steinmüller Engineering GmbHの持分の譲渡に関するお知らせ
items.excerpt: IHI resolved to sell all shares in Steinmüller Engineering to a Mutares subsidiary, with closing planned for mid-October. The unit provides combustion/incineration, flue-gas treatment, heat-exchange and engineering-consulting services. This is a pending engineering-services portfolio change, not a completed sale.
items.query: site:ihi.co.jp 2026 10 航空 エンジン 技術 ニュース after:2026-09-12 before:2026-10-13

items.title: PhysicsX Launches Asia-Pacific Hub in Singapore to Scale AI-Powered Industrial Engineering Across the Region
items.excerpt: PhysicsX announced a Singapore hub and a five-year S$40 million partnership with A*STAR for AI engineering simulation and manufacturing. It says the hub has 20 staff and targets more than 100 within three years. Maritime, advanced manufacturing, semiconductors and biotechnology are named; no measured speedup is reported.
items.document_type: R&D partnership and regional hub announcement
